name: Treasure Hunters
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Runner
specialRules.description: If this model has Runner, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Runner (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -2" range to a min. of 6" when charging it.

specialRules.name: Bravery
specialRules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

specialRules.name: Runner
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Precision Spotter
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. Friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to hit to get +X to hit rolls when attacking, where X is the number of removed tokens.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighting Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Fracture
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Agile
specialRules.description: If this model has Agile, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Agile (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.
